entries.name: Change Document Unit
entries.title: Change Document Unit
entries.summary: Sets the document's unit system and the individual length, angle, mass, volume, time, force, power and energy units. Optionally switches inch dimensions to fractions.

entries.name: Change Drawing Template
entries.title: Change Drawing Template
entries.summary: Applies a `.slddrt` sheet format to one sheet, several named sheets, or every sheet in a drawing, then rebuilds and saves.

entries.name: Insert Block In Drawings
entries.title: Insert Block In Drawings
entries.summary: Inserts a `.sldblk` sketch block at a fixed position on one sheet, several named sheets, or every sheet in a drawing, then rebuilds and saves.

entries.name: Save PDF
entries.title: Save PDF
entries.summary: Exports the open document to PDF. Works on parts, assemblies and drawings.

entries.name: Save with Performance Improvement
entries.title: Save with Performance Improvement
entries.summary: Turns image quality down to its cheapest settings — shaded deviation at maximum, high-quality edges off, wireframe quality at its lowest — then saves a copy named `<name>_Optimized`.
